verdict.rationale: NetHunt says ChatGPT, Claude, or any MCP-compatible assistant can connect to it, and a probe found a live OpenAPI spec, so an agent has a first-party way to reach CRM data. The CRM also stores synced email, deals, and call summaries. However, nothing shows which records the MCP connection or API exposes to an agent, so a brief combining deals, emails, and history is only implied. Missing for 10: documentation of the MCP tools or API endpoints that expose deals, email threads, and activity history; any example of assembling an account brief; independent or hands-on confirmation that the MCP connection works.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent compile an account brief — open deals, recent emails, and history — from CRM data via the API or MCP server before a meeting

citations.quote: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, or any MCP-compatible assistant to NetHunt in a few clicks.
Keep track of every call with the customer with a summary of a conversation.
